headline: 川普兒童投資帳戶惹疑慮
context: 川普大力吹捧「川普帳戶」（Trump accounts）——一項聯邦兒童投資帳戶計畫，聲稱能讓孩子們未來坐擁百萬財富。但專家對這項計畫的效果持保留態度。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: President has hyped growth of federal investment accounts to help US children – for his own political gain Since returning to the White House, Donald Trump has scrapped rules that made childcare more affordable and pushed to cut funding for the nation’s public schools . But with midterm elections fast approaching and his approval ratings very low, the US president has repeatedly trumpeted a two-month-old program designed to help the nation’s children. That program, unhumbly named “ Trump accounts ”, calls for the federal government to give a one-time $1,000 seed deposit to every newborn whose family applies. In campaign speeches this summer , Trump has sought to milk these accounts for maximum political advantage, making big promises about how much these accounts will help the nation’s children. In a speech in Las Vegas last month, Trump hailed the program, saying: “It’s really giving [children] a head start on the American dream… They start off with $1,000 … and they can end up with $100,000, $200,000, $300,000” and if the stock market booms, “you’d end up with $1m”. thread_text:
川普兒童投資帳戶惹疑慮

川普大力吹捧一項名為「川普帳戶」（Trump accounts）的聯邦兒童投資帳戶計畫，聲稱能讓美國孩子未來坐擁百萬財富。

不過專家對這項計畫的實際效果持保留態度，也有分析認為，川普此舉帶有政治宣傳的意味。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 13 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
川普兒童投資帳戶惹疑慮

自重返白宮以來，川普大力吹捧一項名為「川普帳戶」（Trump accounts）的聯邦兒童投資帳戶計畫，聲稱能幫助美國孩子累積財富、未來坐擁百萬身家。

不過專家對這項計畫的實際效果抱持懷疑，分析也指出，川普此舉背後帶有為自己累積政治資本的意味。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 13 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 川普又在推銷他的兒童投資帳戶了。這項計畫叫做「川普帳戶」，他宣稱能幫美國孩子未來坐擁百萬財富。不過專家對實際效果持保留態度——也有人認為，這背後其實帶有政治盤算。
